notes.title: Doom Survivors Demo V 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Doom Survivors Demo Version 1.1.0 has been released! This update opens all difficulty levels for Map 1, Mode 1, and has increased the number of elite enemies.

Version 1.1.0


Adjusted the attack power and health of the charging monsters slightly.
Opened the 4th and 5th difficulty levels for Map 1, Mode 1.
As the game difficulty increases, the movement speed of the monsters increases accordingly.

notes.title: Doom Survivors Demo V 1.09 Update !
notes.notes:
Doom Survivors Demo V 1.09 is now released! This update has refined the map of Chapter 2 and added sound effects for the release of certain skills.

version 1.09

[olist]
The monster generation method in Chapter 2 has been changed to prevent them from spawning too close to the player.
The item generation method on the map of Chapter 2 has been adjusted to avoid placing items in unreachable locations for the player.
Added sound effects for the release of character skills.
Added sound effects for the release of the Meteor Strike skill.
[/olist]

notes.title: Doom Survivors Demo V 1.08 Update
notes.notes:
Doom Survivors Demo V 1.08 is now released! This update includes a revamp of the second chapter's map, and we have further optimized the difficulty for the early stages of the game. We have increased the experience points dropped by monsters in battles, allowing players to level up more quickly. Additionally, we have reduced the attack power of the charging monsters, giving players more strategic options and room to maneuver when facing these formidable foes.

Version 1.08


Updated the first three levels of the second chapter's map mode 1
The attack power of Charging Bats has been reduced to 3
The attack power of the first two waves of monsters has been reduced to 5
Joana's active skill cooldown time has been reduced from 90 seconds to 60 seconds
Aria's active skill cooldown time has been reduced from 60 seconds to 40 seconds
Krag's active skill cooldown time has been reduced from 50 seconds to 30 seconds
Item refresh time has been reduced from 75 seconds to 60 seconds
The cooldown time for Flamestorm (evolution of Fireball) has been reduced from 2.2 seconds to 1.7 seconds

notes.title: Doom Survivors Demo V 1.07 Update
notes.notes:
Doom Survivors Demo V 1.07 has been released! This update optimizes the difficulty of the early game by reducing the number of certain monsters and appropriately lowering their health points, providing a more balanced and enjoyable gaming experience.

Version 1.07


Reduced the attack power of the Charge Bats.
At 1:00, the health of the Goblins is reduced.
At 5:00, the health of the Skeletons is reduced.
At 7:00, the number of monsters increases.
At 9:00, the number of monsters increases.

notes.title: Doom Survivors Demo V 1.05 Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to Doom Survivors Demo V 1.05! This patch addresses minor bugs and introduces controller support.

Version 1.05

Controller Support Added: You can now control the game with your favorite gamepad.

Injury Feedback: Characters will now have noticeable visual and audio effects when taking damage.

Text Revision: Text errors in the game have been corrected for an improved reading experience.

Key Binding Conflicts Fixed: Resolved issues with key binding conflicts during skill activation.
